# Brand identity: voice, visual identity and asset workflows with scripts

Curated by Skill Harbor — the brand skill from nextlevelbuilder's UI/UX pro collection: brand voice, visual identity, messaging frameworks, asset management and brand consistency, backed by working scripts. Includes inject-brand-context.cjs (extract brand context for prompt injection, JSON or human), validate-asset.cjs (naming/size/format checks), extract-colors.cjs (compare image colors against the palette), sync-brand-to-tokens.cjs (brand-guidelines.md → design-tokens.json/css), a guidelines starter template, and reference docs for voice, visual identity, messaging, logo usage, typography, color management and approval checklists. Script paths are relative to the SKILL.md's own directory (sibling sub-skills live alongside it) while scripts read and write project files (docs/brand-guidelines.md, assets/design-tokens.json, src/). Honest caveat: the sync stops when it detects existing token files or Tailwind theme variables — review the reported source before forcing with --force; the skill assumes a Node environment for its scripts. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
